title: 🎃 Costume Exchange
description: Drop off gently used costumes from previous years, and pick up a new-to-you favorite completely for free!
details: Drop-off: Sundays or Monday evenings, Oct 4-12
Help Needed sorting and disbursing costumes at the event from 6-7pm

title: 🎃 Costume DIY
description: Combine your new-to-you costume with your own custom accessories
details: Unleash your creativity to make masks, headbands, capes, accessories, etc
Help needed at the event to help others with gluing, sewing, cutting, designing at the event from 6:30-7:30

title: 🕵️‍♂️ Scavenger Hunt
description: Navigate through 3 to 4 themed rooms to solve riddles, collect clues, and win treats.
details: Areas: Carnival, Mad Lab, Spooky Forest
Help Needed for character roles and decorating
Mad Scientist: Kids will look for clues in the scientist's messy lab
Fortune Teller: Tell participant's fortunes from a crystal ball
Witch: Give participants a potion to try from her brew (pickle juice or something sweet) in order to earn a clue

title: Carnival Games
details: Design a Game to bring and supervise at the event from 6:30-7:30
Ideas: Ball Toss into Monster's mouth (cornhole with decorations), Broom racing, Ring Toss, Pick the Witch's Nose, Pin the Spider on the Web, Human whackamole, etc

title: 💃 Just Dance Dance-Along
description: Follow the moves on the big screen! High-energy dance tracking for kids and parents alike.
details: Sign-up to lead a dance; please provide youtube link to song you want to lead; dancing starts at 7:30

title: 📸 Photo Ops
description: Photo opportunity for the perfect family photo. Bring your own phone or camera!
details: Help needed for set-up and clean-up photo backdrop, lights, and tripod
